name: Helping Others
overview: Scripture commands believers to generously assist the poor and needy, emphasizing that helping others is both a duty and a blessing. Deuteronomy instructs us to open our hands wide to those in need among us, while Proverbs highlights that showing compassion to the poor is as if lending to the Lord Himself, who will repay such kindness. Jesus teaches that our good works, including giving to those who ask or borrow, should shine as a testimony to glorify God, demonstrating that helping others is integral to living out a Christ-centered faith.
